notes: Throughput recipe for the 20B. The lossless wins here are: chunked LM-head loss (no [B, S, 128256] logits buffer in the training step), prefetched + pinned data feeding, one token buffer per batch instead of three int64 copies, fixed accumulation (the loop no longer scales the loss twice and steps per micro-batch), and the mask path no longer forcing the quadratic attention kernel. CPU offload of optimizer state and parameters stays ON by default: with ZeRO-3 on 8 ranks the fully resident recipe needs ~66 GiB/rank, and 24.98B means fp32 master weights + Adam moments alone are ~23 GiB/rank. Run scripts/plan_training_memory.py --budget_gb <your card> to see whether residency fits yours; if it does, set offload_* to false and expect the largest single speed win in this file.

compile.note: torch.compile on the block stack; opt-in because it costs a few minutes of warmup on the first steps.
